# ECSS / NPR / IACS traceability

Every new requirement, design element, and test must trace back to a controlling standard objective. The single source of truth is `docs/traceability.csv` (lands in PR-10 `p10-verification`; PR-3 seeds the header row).

## Row format

```csv
id,kind,parent,description,implemented_by,verified_by,standard_objective,phase,profile
TETHYS-REQ-0042,REQ,TETHYS-REQ-0001,"DAQ logs DAQ_GAP event on CTR mismatch",slave/src/core/daq.c,slave/tests/daq_gap_test.c,ECSS-E-ST-40C-Rev1 Â§5.4.3.1; ISO 26262-6:2018 Â§6.4.3,3,marine|space
```

## When to add a row

- New protocol command, new transport, new profile invariant, new fault-injection scenario.
- New ADR (each ADR's rationale traces to â‰¥1 standard objective).
- New test that covers a previously untraced behaviour.

## When NOT to add a row

- Refactor that preserves semantics (no behaviour change).
- Comment-only / docs-only changes.
- Pure scaffolding (uv init / cmake-init emissions).

## Verification

PR-10 `p10-verification` adds a CI step that diffs the set of files in `slave/src/core/`, `master/src/tethys_master/protocol/`, and `slave/tests/` against the `implemented_by` + `verified_by` columns of `docs/traceability.csv` and flags untraced new files.
